raw_segments.text: In the parliamentary inquiry in 1764, the witnesses stated the price of the choice pieces
of the best beef to be to the consumer 4D, and 4.5D, the pound, and the course pieces
in general to be from seven farthings to 2.5D, and 2.75D, and this, they said, was in general
one hapenny dearer than the same sort of pieces had usually been sold in the month of March.
But even this high price is still a good deal cheaper than what we can well suppose the
ordinary retail price to have been in the time of Prince Henry.
